# Baseline telemetry paths an ACS typically requests from a TR-098 (InternetGatewayDevice.*) CPE,
# used by TestFlagshipProfilesCoverACSTelemetry to prove the flagship
# example profiles answer a real telemetry poll without faulting 9005.
# Includes the vendor tier, since the flagship profile plays an Arris NVG.
#
# Checked in deliberately so the test is self-contained. To refresh,
# export the path list from your ACS's telemetry profile and replace the
# lines below; keep one path per line and leave blank lines out.
